name: Malingering
overview: The Scripture passage in 1 Samuel 21:13-15 presents a vivid example of malingering through David's deliberate act of feigning madness before Achish and his servants. David altered his behavior, making marks on the doors and letting his spittle fall to appear insane, which caused Achish to question why such a man was brought before him. This incident illustrates a strategic use of deception to avoid harm, revealing a complex interaction between survival and integrity in a challenging situation.
